description: Unified critical-state model for clays and sands. New in the 9.x series (documented in the official Itasca 9.7 manual; absent from FLAC3D 7.0). Property names below are the authoritative props() keys read back live from FLAC3D 9.7 (2026-08-13); per-property descriptions are not yet curated - see the official 9.7 HTML manual for semantics.

property_groups.name: Properties
property_groups.description: Property keywords accepted by 'zone property' with the 'clay-and-sand' model assigned (names from the engine; what they do is not documented).

properties.description: critical state parameters, \Gamma. This value represents the void ratio (not the specific volume, as used in some literature) at the critical state when p = 1 kPa. is the Typical values are in the range 0.8 to 3.0.
critical state parameters, or slope of normal consolidation line, \lambda. It should be greater than \kappa. Typical value are 0.01 to 0.05 for sands, and 0.1 to 0.2 for clays.
slope of elastic swelling line, \kappa. It should be less than \lambda. Typical values are around 0.005 for sands and 0.01 to 0.06 for clays.
initial over consolidation ratio, OCR_0. Allowable values are 1.0 or more.
Poisson’s ratio, \nu. Typical values are 0.15 to 0.35 for sands and clays. The default value is 0.2.
exponent in the plastic potential function, m. Typical values are 2.0 to 4.0. If m = -1, the original Yu (1998) plastic potential function is used.
current cap pressure of the yield surface, p_N.
notes: Read-only per the manual, but live FLAC3D 9.8 accepts a write to it.

properties.description: reference pressure, p_{ref}. The value is usually 100.0 if in kPa, or the equivalent in other units.
stress ratio q/p at critical state in the triaxial compression test, M. A typical value is 0.8 to 1.0 for clays and 1.1 to 1.4 for sands.
spacing ratio, R. Typical values are 1.5 to 3.0 for clays and much larger (to thousands) for sands.
initial state parameter, \psi_0. The allowable maximum value is (\lambda - \kappa) \ln{R}.
initial stress tensor, \sigma_{ij,0}. It should not be outside of the initial yield surface.
exponent in the yield function, n. Typical values are 1.0 to 5.0.

source: live FLAC3D 9.7 enumeration (2026-08-13); model page exists in the official Itasca 9.7 manual
